meta.name: hreflang-international
meta.description: International / multilingual SEO audit focused on hreflang correctness. Detects and diagnoses the most common (and ranking-damaging) hreflang mistakes: missing or broken return tags, wrong language/region codes, missing x-default, self-referencing errors, conflicts between hreflang and canonical, and inconsistent signals across HTML head / HTTP headers / XML sitemap. Also reviews the broader international setup — URL structure (ccTLD vs subdirectory vs subdomain), language targeting, and geo signals. Use this skill whenever the user runs a multi-language or multi-region site and asks about hreflang, international SEO, multilingual SEO, the wrong-language page showing in search, duplicate-content across country versions, or "th/en page ranking in the wrong country".
